items.title: Codex CLI installs a persistent, self-updating background daemon by default
items.summary: 📝 0, just opening an interactive codex session: Starts a persistent background daemon (codex app-server --managed-daemon). It runs in its own session with no TTY and keeps running after every Codex window is closed (reparented to PID 1) until codex app-server daemon stop or a reboot. Workaround I'm using: codex features disable daemon_auto_start codex app-server daemon stop pkill -f 'app-server daemon pid-update-loop' # not stopped by `daemon stop` rm -rf ~/.🔗 Read more: https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/48195
